title: Apprenticeship Levy Manual
summary: Guidance on the Apprenticeship Levy which applies to employers whose paybill exceeds a specific threshold.

title: Disclosing VAT and other indirect tax avoidance schemes (VAT Notice 799)
summary: Find out the rules from 1 January 2018 if you promote or use arrangements that are meant to give someone a VAT or other indirect tax saving or a tax deferral.

title: Disclosure of VAT avoidance schemes (VAT Notice 700/8)
summary: Find out the rules on disclosing arrangements and transactions that provide a VAT advantage.

title: Disclosure of tax avoidance schemes
summary: Find out the rules for disclosure of VAT, indirect and direct taxes, Apprenticeship Levy and National Insurance contributions avoidance schemes and penalties for non-disclosure.

title: Forms to disclose tax avoidance schemes
summary: Find out which form to use in different circumstances.

title: Guidance: Disclosure of tax avoidance schemes: guidance
summary: This guidance will help you work out if you need to tell HMRC that you use or promote a tax avoidance scheme.

title: Form: Tell HMRC your Inheritance Tax scheme reference number
summary: Use form AAG4(IHT) to tell HMRC of a scheme reference number given to you for an Inheritance Tax avoidance scheme you have used.

title: Form: Tell HMRC your Stamp Duty Land Tax scheme reference number
summary: Use form AAG4(SDLT) to tell HMRC of a scheme reference number given to you for a Stamp Duty Land Tax (SDLT) avoidance scheme you have used.

title: Form: Tax avoidance schemes: notification by scheme promoter (AAG1)
summary: Tell HMRC if you're a promoter of notifiable arrangements to disclose an avoidance scheme.

title: Form: Tax avoidance schemes: disclosure by scheme user where offshore promoter doesn't notify (AAG2)
summary: Use form AAG2 if you use a notifiable arrangement but the offshore promoter has not told HMRC about the avoidance scheme.

title: Form: Tax avoidance schemes: notification by scheme user where no promoter, or promoted by lawyer who can't make full notification (AAG3)
summary: Tell HMRC if you're a user of a scheme that has no promoter or is promoted by a lawyer who can't make a full notification.

title: Form: Tell HMRC your tax avoidance scheme reference number
summary: Use form AAG4 to tell HMRC of a scheme reference number given to you for a tax avoidance scheme you have used.

title: Form: Tell HMRC your ATED tax avoidance scheme reference number
summary: Use form AAG4(ATED) to tell HMRC of a scheme reference number given to you for an Annual Tax on Enveloped Dwellings (ATED) avoidance scheme you have used.

title: Form: Tax avoidance schemes: disclosure of details about employees in relation to avoidance schemes (AAG8)
summary: Use form AAG8 if you're an employer to provide an end of year notification in relation to avoidance schemes.

title: Mandatory payrolling of benefits in kind and expenses – interim guidance and legislation
summary: Draft interim guidance and legislation to aid preparation for reporting benefits in kind (BiKs) and expenses in real time, through payroll software, from April 2027.

title: Annex 3 – additional benefits in kind fields likely to be required on Full Payment Submission returns
summary: Information about the additional benefits in kind (BiKs) fields likely to be required on Full Payment Submission (FPS) returns.

title: Check genuine HMRC contact that uses more than one communication method
summary: Check recent contacts from HMRC to help you decide if a suspicious email, phone call, text or letter could be a scam.

title: Find out about the Non-Statutory Clearance Service
summary: How to use the Non-Statutory Clearance Service offered by HMRC for all customers and their advisers.

title: Notice: Notice IPT1: Insurance Premium Tax
summary: This notice gives guidance on Insurance Premium Tax (IPT), what it is, who it applies to and how to pay it.

title: The default operation of mandatory payrolling
summary: Real time reporting of benefits in kind and expenses from April 2027.
